summary: Telesat Corp filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing a Board of Directors change. Ralph (Cody) Kittle, a nominee of MHR Fund Management LLC, was appointed to succeed Michael Targoff, a previous MHR nominee. Kittle is founder and CEO of RenWave Kore and former Elliott Management portfolio manager. The board chair welcomed Kittle and thanked Targoff for nearly 19 years of service. This is a routine board succession by an activist-linked nominee, not a forced departure or contested election, but it is disclosed as a standalone event via press release, warranting classification as Management Changes. No deal terms apply.
